candidates.change_summary: Change block offset from +1 to +0 so settle uses the current block hash instead of the next block's hash.
Change block offset from +1 to +2 so settle uses a different future block hash.
Delete the line that sets guesses[msg.sender].block so it remains zero, preventing settle from ever proceeding.
Delete the guess assignment so the stored guess remains bytes32(0), changing the condition checked in settle.
Delete the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so lockInGuess can be called with zero payment, altering contract balance and possible payouts.
Change require value from 1 ether to 0 ether so users can lock in without payment.
Change require value from 1 ether to 2 ether so lockInGuess requires more funds.
Insert an additional assignment that adds 1 to block number, making the stored block off by one.
Remove the require that checks the guesser has sent 1 ether, allowing zero-value settlements to still transfer 2 ether.
Change the transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, altering the balance change observable after a successful settle.
Remove the balance check so that settle can succeed even if the contract has less than 2 ether, then transfer nonetheless.
Change the answer computation to use a different block number (block.number) so that a correct guess never matches.
